messages.text: Happy to. Two quick things: is this your first miner or adding to a setup, and roughly what do you pay for power?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 6 TH/s

The B. BS-1 is off sale right now while BitFortun fixes its firmware — there's a Notify me button on its page.

The closest thing you can buy today is the Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s at $239, ~100W. That's about $7 a month in power at 10¢, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes, forever.

First miner?

Good place to start. The B.04 is the one people get first — it's quiet enough for a desk, sips 100W, and you learn pools, wallets and firmware on a real machine you can hear running.

$239, ships from our warehouse in 2–5 business days. What do you pay per kWh, and I'll run the sats and the block odds for you?

Yes — Hungary's covered. The B.04 plug is matched to your address, shipping to rest-of-Europe starts around $21.99.

One honest heads-up: the $239 excludes VAT. It ships from our warehouse and 21% import VAT plus any duty is collected on delivery, not at checkout.

Still want me to run the numbers? Just tell me your per-kWh rate.
